# Daily Report — 2026-09-07

## Task Completed
Added PA job management tools (`list_pa_jobs`, `get_pa_job`, `trigger_pa_collection`) on the
`pa_job` table.  PA jobs are the scheduled or on-demand processes that collect Performance
Analytics indicator scores.

- `list_pa_jobs` — lists collection jobs with filters for name, active flag, run_type,
  last_run_status, and indicator (name/sys_id auto-resolved); pagination with has_more/next_offset.
- `get_pa_job` — retrieves a single job by sys_id or exact name via `_resolve_pa_job_sys_id`.
- `trigger_pa_collection` — PATCHes `run_now=true` on the target job record to queue an immediate
  on-demand collection run.

New constants/fields: `PA_JOB_TABLE`, `PA_JOB_FIELDS`.  New helpers:
`_format_pa_job`, `_resolve_pa_job_sys_id`.  Three new Pydantic models:
`ListPAJobsParams`, `GetPAJobParams`, `TriggerPACollectionParams`.

All three tools registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
